name: Barbell Bench Press
setup: Set the rack so you can unrack the bar with nearly straight elbows. Plant both feet and set your shoulder blades on the bench.
cues: Lower the bar under control toward your lower chest. Keep your wrists over your elbows and press back toward the rack.

name: Barbell Row
setup: Take an overhand grip and hinge until the bar hangs below your shoulders.
cues: Brace your trunk and pull toward your lower ribs. Lower to straight arms without lifting your torso.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
setup: Start with the bar at upper-chest height and your forearms nearly vertical.
cues: Brace with your ribs stacked over your hips. Move your head just enough for the bar to pass, then finish with the bar over your midfoot.

name: Cable Lat Pulldown
setup: Set the thigh pad so your legs stay anchored and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
cues: Drive your elbows down toward your sides. Return to a full reach without letting the stack slam.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
setup: Set the pulley high and stand close enough to keep your elbows by your sides.
cues: Straighten your elbows without moving your upper arms. Control the return.

name: Barbell Back Squat
setup: Set the bar on your upper back and adjust the safeties below your working depth.
cues: Brace before descending. Let your knees track with your toes and keep pressure through the whole foot.

name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
setup: Stand with the bar against your thighs and a small bend in your knees.
cues: Reach your hips back and keep the bar close. Stop where you can keep your trunk position, then drive your hips forward.

name: Standing Calf Raise
setup: Adjust the pads to your shoulder height and set the balls of your feet on the platform.
cues: Move through the ankle from a controlled stretch to a high heel position. Keep your knee angle steady.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
setup: Set a flat bench and bring the dumbbells over your shoulders with your feet planted.
cues: Lower with your forearms nearly vertical. Press the dumbbells up without knocking them together.

name: Machine Chest Press
setup: Adjust the seat so the handles start around mid-chest. Set a comfortable start position.
cues: Keep your upper back against the pad and guide the handles back under control.

machineSetup.handle: Neutral or overhand, record your choice

name: Push-Up
setup: Start in a plank with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
cues: Lower your chest as your hips and shoulders move together. Press back to the plank.

name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
setup: Hold a dumbbell upright at chest height and take a comfortable squat stance.
cues: Keep the dumbbell close, sit between your hips, and stand through your whole foot.

name: Seated Leg Curl
setup: Align your knees with the machine pivot and place the ankle pad just above your heels.
cues: Curl with your hips against the seat. Return until your knees straighten comfortably.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
setup: Place your free hand on a stable bench and hinge with your working arm hanging below your shoulder.
cues: Draw your working elbow back toward your hip. Lower without rotating your torso.
